findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "propose_profile_update" is 1572 chars, far longer than this server's median (311). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: propose_profile_update, propose_pitch_draft, propose_pitch_send · Private data: read_invoices · Public sink: propose_brief_publish, propose_team_invite, propose_pitch_send · Destructive: propose_profile_update.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: propose_profile_update, propose_pitch_draft, propose_pitch_send · Private data: read_invoices · Public sink: propose_brief_publish, propose_team_invite, propose_pitch_send · Destructive: propose_profile_update

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
